summary: Parker-Hannifin filed an 8-K on September 4, 2026, updating financing for its announced acquisition of CIRCOR International's Commercial and Defense Aerospace business for approximately $2.55 billion in cash, a deal first announced May 21, 2026. The company entered a new $5.0 billion revolving credit agreement, upsized its commercial paper program to $5.0 billion, and expects a three-year delayed draw term loan of up to $2.0 billion with U.S. Bank as administrative agent. Proceeds fund part of the purchase price; closing conditions and regulatory timing remain, so watch financing spreads and deal-close risk.
